terms.gloss: hold first place, be the best
evidence: Cic. Brut. 327: prīmās tenēre, to play the first part, be the best (Lewis & Short s.v. prīmus)
terms.comment: prīmās is short for prīmās partēs; so secundās (tertiās) tenēre, second (third) place, after Cicero’s huic secundās, huic tertiās (de Or. 3.213).
